About

My background

At General Motors, I worked on digital commerce as a Scrum Master supporting Shop Click Drive and CarBravo.

My technical program management experience now informs my independent product work. I interview the people doing the work, build a first version, and test the parts of a decision that are easiest to get wrong.

Independent product work / Browser extension

Natural Fiber Filter

A shopper looking for natural fibers often has to open each listing to read the fabric composition. I built a Chrome extension that checks those details from the product grid.

What to do with missing details

The extension checks each product’s material information against the shopper’s rules. It hides verified nonmatches and keeps products with unreadable or missing composition visible. A missing label leaves the shopper with an open question.

What the replay showed

In a Chrome replay of 70 Free People listings, 24 matched the rules, 31 were hidden by the rules, and 15 remained visible with unknown composition. Hiding every unknown would also have removed those 15 from view.

What I would test next

I would ask shoppers to find a garment with their preferred material and explain why an unknown item is still on screen. Their answers would tell me whether the default needs a clearer label or a different control.

24Matched
31Hidden by rules
15Unknown, visible

← Selected work
Founding product manager / Chrome extension

CareerFit AI

A job seeker weighing a listing has two documents to compare. CareerFit AI brings their résumé and the role requirements together inside the page they’re reading.

Put the assessment in context

A compact toolbar opens a fit assessment beside the original posting. The extension compares the description with the applicant’s résumé, displays a score from one to five, and highlights role requirements and skills to develop.

From setup to the first assessment

A first-time user could analyze a résumé and immediately see “Profile not found.” After fixing how the extension retrieves the saved profile, a fresh-browser test ran all the way from setup to assessment and saving a skill. The test used a sample résumé and simulated AI responses.

View the extension walkthrough ↗

A question for the next test

Can a job seeker explain why a role received its score using evidence from their résumé and the listing? I would test that before using the score to steer more application decisions.
